import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# cold box
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,1), 3, 2.5, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(1.2,2.2,'cold box', fontsize=10)
ax.text(1.2,1.7,'2x PV roof', fontsize=9)
# roof PV
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.8,3.6), 3.4, 0.6, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(1.5,3.8,'2 modules vent gap', fontsize=8)
# ground frame 7 modules
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((5.5,1), 4, 2.0, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(5.7,2.5,'7 modules ground frame', fontsize=9)
for i in range(7):
    x=5.7+i*0.5
    ax.plot([x,x],[1.1,2.2])
ax.text(5.7,0.6,'9x400W=3.6kWp ~17.6 m2', fontsize=9)
ax.text(1,0.6,'battery box vented', fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.1), 1, 0.4, fill=False))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
